summary: Parked-up residential kerb; houses 12-21 m away on this side.

best_section.where: Middle of the south kerb, opposite the red-brick house

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 12-21 m behind the kerb and more homes across the road; no bush or open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along both kerbs; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a bend; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here day and night; no visible campervans.
